description: Fetches a publicly available YouTube caption track and returns it to the calling AI for summarization. This server does not transcribe audio, run an LLM, or require an API key; it relies on ChatGPT or the connected MCP client to summarize the returned captions.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1/BCP-47 language code, including regional or script subtags such as "pt-BR" or "zh-Hans"

style.description: How the calling AI should format the summary

videoIdOrUrl.description: The YouTube video URL or raw 11-character video ID

name: summarize_youtube_transcript
title: Summarize YouTube Transcript
